rate_limits.correction: The policy is published: there is no request limit, but abusive or inappropriate requests may be rejected; users should notify the provider if their service regularly generates more than 10,000 requests per day.

description.correction: Public HTTPS API from goqr.me that generates PNG, GIF, JPEG/JPG, SVG, or EPS QR-code images from submitted data without signup. The official create endpoint does not document additional output formats.

notes: The API and documented v1 endpoint remain available. The decisive error is that rate limits are described as unpublished even though the official documentation publishes a no-request-limit policy, abuse exception, and 10,000-requests/day notification threshold. The description also overstates the documented image formats. CORS could not be established from official documentation.
